gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns the missing quantitative supremum/C(H¹) estimate in a continuity lemma. ISSUE-002 concerns incorrectly stated weak-convergence spaces in a different stability proof; it does not identify the missing norm control or its proof obligation.

Both identify the negative boundary average convention for the second normal derivative as causing the boundary consistency term to reinforce rather than cancel the integration-by-parts contribution, thereby violating the discrete consistency assumption. ISSUE-001 also supplies the corresponding sign correction.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The printed C⁰ interior-penalty boundary sign convention prevents cancellation of the boundary consistency terms, so the form fails the asserted discrete consistency identity; changing the boundary average to the positive outward-normal convention repairs it.

component_coverage.gold_component: The boundary average and jump signs combine with the integration-by-parts boundary contribution with the wrong sign, so the consistency terms reinforce instead of canceling and the discrete consistency assumption fails.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly states the negative boundary average, explains that it prevents cancellation and makes the form inconsistent, and gives the positive-sign correction.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue is an incorrect pressure antiderivative for a singular force perturbation, requiring differentiation of the proposed pressure and correction of its exponent and coefficient. ISSUE-001 concerns boundary signs and discrete consistency of a finite-element bilinear form, with no pressure formula or force-gradient calculation.
